artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan (9h, four waves) transcribing the two sorry-free probes into five new modules, assembling plus_incomplete_base with a C14 axiom pin, and sweeping every README/docstring that says TM+ completeness is open; ZTime corollary excluded as a follow-up.

memory_candidates.content: Lean plan authoring against lean-challenge-snapshot.sh: (1) the tool forces EVERY declaration body in the plan's '## Lean Challenge Statements' block to sorry, including a def, so a challenge theorem that mentions a to-be-defined def is meaningless; write the defined term out in full in the challenge statement and note in the plan that the landed theorem is stated through the def (definitionally equal), so an advisory textual-drift verdict on that identifier is expected. (2) The Goals identifier set is extracted by a backtick regex over everything between the line '**Goals**:' and the next line starting with '**' plus a non-G character; any plain backticked identifier in that region (even PlusValid or a helper name) becomes a goal and causes an exit-71 identifier-set mismatch. Backtick only the challenge theorem names inside Goals; dotted names and paths do not match the regex. (3) Verify with 'lean-challenge-snapshot.sh N . --dry-run' (writes nothing) and type-check the block with bare lean against built oleans.
